content.text:
I can't give you an official time-on-market number for houses in Hamburg yet. The methodology for it (`time_on_market`, v1, median days on market by month) is still a draft and hasn't been approved, so I didn't calculate a figure myself.

**Why it's still a draft:**
- The code that builds the underlying listings data (last built 2026-08-13) can't be found. As a result, there are no agreed rules for when a listing starts or ends, or for removing duplicate listings.
- The data is matched to places by name instead of by place ID, which can mix up places that share a name.

**What happens next:** I've logged your request for the team (issue ID `7681ed9b-3564-4319-aad6-5025fa71284f`). Once those rules are defined and the methodology is approved, it will support Hamburg, houses or apartments, and buying or renting.

**What you can get now:**
- An official house price growth figure for Hamburg (supported windows: 1m, 3m, 6m, YTD, 1y, 2y, 3y, 5y, all).
- An official purchasing power figure: how many m² a median-income single person or family can afford.
- An exploratory look at days on market from the raw listings data. It would be clearly labelled as unofficial and could change once the methodology is finalised.
